TextArea widget

Source: R/widget-textarea.R
TextArea-class.Rd

A multi-line text editor. See text_area().

Super class

Widget -> TextArea

Public fields

focusable

Text areas can be focused.

placeholder

Text shown while the area is empty.

line_numbers

Show a line number gutter?

wrap

Wrap long lines (TRUE) or scroll horizontally?

read_only

Block editing (cursor, selection, copy and search still work)?

language

Optional language name passed to the configured highlighter.

tab_size

Spaces inserted by Tab (and used for tabs in loaded text).

tab_behavior

"focus": Tab moves focus (default, safe in forms); "indent": Tab inserts spaces and Shift+Tab removes them.

auto_indent

Copy the indentation of the current line on Enter?

highlighter

Optional function (lines, state) returning a list of per-line data frames with 1-based inclusive start, end, token.

validate

NULL or function(value) returning NULL (valid) or an error message.

Active bindings

value

The text. Assigning replaces it (see set_text()).

text

The text (read-only alias of value).

lines

The lines as a character vector.

n_lines

Number of lines.

cursor_row, cursor_column

Cursor position, 1-based (column 1 is before the first character).

selection

The selected text ("" if none).

can_undo, can_redo

Is there something to undo / redo?

history_size

Characters held by the undo history.

match_count

Number of matches of the current search.

find_open

Is the find bar open?

valid

Does the value pass validate?

error

The validation message, or NULL.

TextArea$new()

Create a text area.

Usage

TextArea$new(
  value = "",
  placeholder = "",
  id = NULL,
  classes = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  disabled = FALSE,
  line_numbers = FALSE,
  wrap = TRUE,
  read_only = FALSE,
  language = NULL,
  tab_size = 4L,
  tab_behavior = "focus",
  auto_indent = FALSE,
  validate = NULL,
  max_history = 200L,
  highlighter = NULL
)

Arguments

value

Initial text.

placeholder

Placeholder text.

id, classes, style, disabled

See Widget.

line_numbers, wrap, read_only, language, tab_size, tab_behavior, auto_indent

See the fields.

validate

Validation function.

max_history

Maximum number of undo steps.

highlighter

Optional function (lines, state) returning a list of per-line data frames with 1-based inclusive start, end, token.

TextArea$on_key()

Printable keys replace the selection or are inserted at the cursor; Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X copy / cut a selection. While the find bar is open, keys edit the search text.

Usage

TextArea$on_key(event)

Arguments

event

A KeyEvent.

TextArea$on_paste()

Pasted text is inserted as one undo step; line breaks are kept.

Usage

TextArea$on_paste(event)

Arguments

event

A PasteEvent.

TextArea$set_text()

Replace the whole text. Clears the undo history and moves the cursor to the start.

Usage

TextArea$set_text(text)

Arguments

text

A string (or character vector of lines).

TextArea$insert()

Insert text at the cursor, replacing the selection.

Usage

TextArea$insert(text, kind = NULL)

Arguments

text

A string; line breaks are kept.

kind

Internal: "type" merges into undo groups, "paste" does not.

Search for text and select the first match at or after the cursor.

TextArea$find(query, case_sensitive = FALSE, regex = FALSE)

Arguments

query

Text or regular expression (PCRE).

Returns

TextArea$replace()

Replace the current search match, or find query and replace its next match.

Usage

TextArea$replace(
  replacement,
  query = NULL,
  case_sensitive = FALSE,
  regex = FALSE
)

Arguments

replacement

Replacement text.

query

Optional search text; defaults to the active search.

case_sensitive, regex

Search options used when query is given.

TextArea$replace_all()

Replace all matches in one document edit. If the edit is larger than the bounded undo budget, it is applied without retaining an undo record.

Usage

TextArea$replace_all(query, replacement, case_sensitive = FALSE, regex = FALSE)

Arguments

query

Search text or regular expression.

replacement

Replacement text.

case_sensitive

Match case?

regex

Interpret query as a regular expression?
